root_cause: Cloudflare WAF intercepts headless Playwright network requests with HTTP 403 Challenge Page; standard HTTP/SSR request (F1) receives full 1.97MB commercial document with 48 products.
pipeline_gap: FalabellaScraper inherited BaseScraper._navigate_internal which only used page.goto and failed on Cloudflare 403 without activating the existing HTTP SSR acquisition fallback.
minimal_fix: Implemented navigate() override in FalabellaScraper that catches Cloudflare challenge and activates HTTP SSR fallback, populating browser page DOM via set_content().
